'''Richard Dobson''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 16th, 4 (−47) at [[September 2001 Milford tournament]] on 1 September 2001, according to Michael Pistone's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2936">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-09-05-madskills-at-milford-mass-9-1-01d2936/ madskills-at-milford-mass-9-1-01], DeckTech (Michael "MadSkills84" Pistone, 5 September 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-09-05-madskills-at-milford-mass-9-1-01d2936/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
